The '''BB-2 Starfire fighter-bomber''' was the main [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] during the [[Sith–Imperial War]] and of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] during the subsequent [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. It was a sleek, multipurpose [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] made by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] that was crewed by three people and armed with multiple [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]] launchers, a forward-firing [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], and turrets for self-defense.

==Characteristics==
The BB-2 Starfire [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]]-[[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] from [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] was a sleek, gently curved, [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]-capable starfighter. Incredibly well armed, the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] primary weapons were multiple [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]] launchers. The BB-2's payload included ten [[interceptor missile]]s, multiple [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] capable of being launched in two massive rapid-fire salvos, and three [[Ion bomb/Legends|ion bombs]]. It could also carry [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bombs]] and other ordnance. Secondary weapon systems included a pair of forward mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], as well as a dorsal turret on each wing that contained a light laser cannon or small anti-fighter [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]].<ref name="LECG" />

Though not as maneuverable as the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance's]] [[CF9 Crossfire starfighter]], the Starfire's pair of massive [[Engine/Legends|engines]] provided it with the same speed. The engines also provided power to the craft's dual [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]]. The Starfire was crewed by three individuals&mdash;a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], a co-pilot, and a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]&mdash;and could carry a [[Standard week/Legends|week's]] worth of consumables. All crew members could operate the weapons, although the pilot usually controlled the forward firing laser cannon. The pilot could fire the [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] and proton torpedoes, but not as accurately as the co-pilot. The co-pilot could also take control of the forward laser cannon or a turret but was mainly in charge of the barrage and bombing systems. The gunner could control either turret, or both of them at the same [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="LECG" />

The Starfire cost 200,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new, 90,000 credits used, and was available only to military forces. It could achieve a speed of 1,200 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] in a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and carry ninety [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of cargo. It was equipped with a Class 1 hyperdrive.<ref name="LECG" />

==Role==
As a bomber, the BB-2 Starfire's primary role was attacks on [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] using a rapid-fire barrage of missiles and proton torpedoes. The standard tactic for the Starfire, employed by the Galactic Alliance during the [[Sith–Imperial War]], was to fire multiple salvos from maximum range, then return to their [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] and reload. Later, these tactics were changed to reduce wasting of precious ordnance. The new tactics included getting as close to an enemy target as possible in order to guarantee a direct hit. Pilots of the Alliance's BB-2s relied on the craft's powerful [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] to survive these types of engagements during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. They were often accompanied by a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of CF9 Crossfire starfighters to provide protection from enemy starfighters.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
The BB-2 Starfire was the main bomber used by the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Galactic Alliance Navy]] during the Sith&ndash;Imperial War and by the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] after the [[Battle of Caamas]] in [[130 ABY]].<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The BB-2 Starfire fighter-bomber was first mentioned in the ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', released in [[2009]]. The ''Legacy Era Campaign Guide'' once mistakenly identified the starship as a ''Torrent'' instead of a ''Starfire''.<ref name="LECG" />
